title: SUPERINTELLIGENCE SPRINT
tagline: Twenty AI agents, one human, five flat-out laps through the city by day.
blurb: A daytime Grand Prix sprint on a 2.2 km street circuit through the city: ten corners between the towers, the Skyline straight and the Needle's twin chicanes. Twenty cars, five laps, and an AI agent at every wheel but yours: you drive the WHY. V-07 with Muse. The field races as a pack around you, so every lap is a fight. Hold the brake through the five red lights, then brake late, take the inside and open the Flap on the Skyline.
